content.text: Historical live action, night inside a Han-era tent. The camera tilts down from Gou An at the low desk to a close view of his right hand and paper. He presses a brush onto one existing short row of faded ink and draws one firm horizontal stroke all the way across the row. He lifts the brush, moves below the crossed-out row, and writes his short signature. He lifts the brush and places it on the brush rest. A single continuous nine-second shot, warm small lamp light, grey linen sleeve, only paper, brush and cloth sounds. No speech or background music.
